about.title: About & Research Methodology
about.subtitle: A public-interest design thinking initiative from Group 5, JAIN (Deemed-to-be University).
about.projectScope: Scheme Access Kit addresses information opacity and administrative hurdles faced by small and marginal farmers in Karnataka — specifically cultivators working drylands and plots under 1 acre.
about.methodStep1: 1. Gazette-Level Grounding: No scheme is listed from news hearsay. Every rule is traced back to an official Government Order (G.O.) or published ministry guideline.
about.methodStep2: 2. Explicit Edge-Case Flagging: Where rules leave ambiguity (such as joint Khatas or deceased ancestor mutations), we mark our recommendation as a hypothesis.
about.methodStep3: 3. Zero Exploitation Architecture: No personal identifiers (Aadhaar, bank numbers, survey numbers) ever cross the network.
about.reportErrorTitle: Report a Discrepancy or Outdated Rule
about.reportErrorDesc: If an official rule changed in your taluk, notify the student desk for rapid verification.
